name: Baasha
title: Third King of Israel
summary: Baasha was the third king of the northern kingdom of Israel. He came to power by killing King Nadab and wiping out the entire house of Jeroboam. Despite prophetic warning, he continued in the sins of Jeroboam and led Israel away from the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Conspiracy Against Nadab
keyEvents.description: Baasha conspired against King Nadab and killed him at Gibbethon while Israel was besieging the Philistine city. This happened in the second year of Asa king of Judah's reign.

keyEvents.title: The Destruction of Jeroboam's House
keyEvents.description: After seizing power, Baasha wiped out the entire family of Jeroboam, leaving no survivors. This fulfilled the word of the prophet Ahijah against Jeroboam.

keyEvents.title: Twenty-four Years of Reign
keyEvents.description: Baasha reigned over Israel for twenty-four years from Tirzah. He continued in the sins of Jeroboam and led Israel into sin against the Lord.

keyEvents.title: The Judgment of the Prophet Jehu
keyEvents.description: The Lord sent the prophet Jehu son of Hanani with a message of judgment against Baasha. Because he persisted in the sins of Jeroboam, his family was to be wiped out in the same way.

keyEvents.title: War Against Judah and the Fortification of Ramah
keyEvents.description: Baasha waged war against Asa king of Judah and fortified Ramah to block all traffic to and from Judah. Asa responded by forming an alliance with Syria, which then attacked Israel.

keyEvents.title: The Death of Baasha
keyEvents.description: Baasha died and was buried in Tirzah. His son Elah succeeded him as king, but his dynasty lasted only two years before it was overthrown.
